title: Abrego Garcia Voluntarily Leaves U.S., Ending 20-Month Legal Fight
summary: Kilmar Armando Abrego Garcia, who was wrongfully deported last year, has left for Spain. He faced the prospect that the Trump administration might deport him to Liberia.
